title: When the Uniform Falls
author: Ines Ravensworth
blurb: Mara Ravensworth, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
